full_judgment: 2. Short facts are that the pre-emptor filed Pre-emption Case No.41 of 1991 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Pirganj, Rangpur under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 for pre-emption against the preemptees and others stating, inter alia, that the land measuring 66 decimals of Plot No.381/628 of C,S. Khatian No.2, S.A. Khatian No.115 originally belonged to Naresh Chanara Basu and Indu Prava Basu in their raiyati right. The C.S. Khatian was accordingly prepared and finally published in their names. Before R.S. Khatian the said Naresh Chandra Basu and Indu Prava Basu after transferring the said land including the case land left for India. Md. Akbar Ali, Munsur Ali, Hosen Ali and Hosen Ali got the case land on the basis of lease. As per the deed of exchange dated 27.12.1986 Md. Akbar Ali transferred 161/2 acres of land to the pre-emptor. In this way the preemptor became a co-sharer in the disputed holding. The pre-emptor has got his homestead in the western portion of the case land. The opposite party No.3 of the pm-emption case sold the case land to the pre-emptee Nos.1 and 2 by a kabala dated 03.04.1991 beyond the knowledge of the preemptor. No notice of the kabala under pre-emption was served upon the pre-emptor. The pre-emptees are stranger purchasers in the case holding. The cause of action of the .case arose when the kabala under pre-emption was registered under section 60 of the Registration Act.
